europe_now.title: Belgium faces largest wildfire on record, seeks European air support
europe_now.summary: Belgium is experiencing its largest wildfire on record and has requested European air support. International assistance is arriving to help combat the blazes.

sources.headline: International help arrives as wildfires rage across Belgium

europe_now.title: French taxpayers warned after major data hack
europe_now.summary: French authorities have warned taxpayers after a major hack exposed personal data. The breach raises concerns about security and privacy for citizens across France.

sources.headline: French taxpayers warned after personal data stolen in major hack

top_stories.title: EU acts against nihilist online extremist network
top_stories.summary: The EU has taken action against a nihilist online extremist network known as ‘The Com’. Officials say the move highlights potential gaps in current security policies.

sources.headline: EU action against ‘The Com’, a nihilist online extremist network, shows that security policies might be outdated

top_stories.title: Latvia seeks EU aid for war fallout
top_stories.summary: Latvia has requested €7 billion from the European Union to address war-related damages. The request aims to support recovery and resilience amid ongoing regional tensions.

sources.headline: Latvia wants €7B from EU to cope with fallout from Russia’s war

top_stories.title: Germany debates banning far-right party
top_stories.summary: German lawmakers are divided over proposals to ban far-right political parties. The debate reflects broader concerns about extremism and democratic stability.

sources.headline: Germany divided over proposals to outlaw the far right

top_stories.title: Sicilian museum hit by major art theft
top_stories.summary: Thieves stole artworks worth approximately €80 million from a museum in Sicily. The incident has prompted investigations into security lapses and cultural heritage protection.

sources.headline: Sicilian museum hit by €80 million art theft
